name: Twingate Starter Free
free_limit: Up to 5 users, 50 Resources, 10 Remote Networks and 5 devices per user; secure remote access with split tunneling and conditional access.
watch_out: Starter has community support only and limited advanced access controls; premium identity, service accounts and device posture features require paid plans. Verify payment-card requirements during signup. The separate startup Enterprise promotion is time-limited and is not this free tier.
